turns.question: Among the 1,000 most liquid US stocks, which five had the weakest returns from January 2 through December 31, 2025?

report.markdown:
Among the 1,000 most liquid US stocks, the five weakest returns from **January 2 through December 31, 2025** were:

| Rank | Asset | Return | Coverage (trading sessions) | Evidence |
|------|-------|--------|----------------------------|----------|
| 1 | CHOW | **‑95.18%** | 75 / 250 (30%) | [1] |
| 2 | BZAI | **‑87.00%** | 249 / 250 (99.6%) | [1] |
| 3 | DFNS | **‑85.92%** | 250 / 250 (100%) | [1] |
| 4 | AEBI | **‑84.81%** | 128 / 250 (51.2%) | [1] |
| 5 | ATOM | **‑82.92%** | 250 / 250 (100%) | [1] |

**Note**: Returns are total returns from the close before the first session (Jan 2) to the last close (Dec 31). Two of the five (CHOW and AEBI) had incomplete trading coverage during the period, so their returns reflect fewer observations.

turns.question: Among the same 1,000 stocks, which five had the strongest returns from January 2, 2025 through March 12, 2026, and were any of them among those five weakest of 2025?

report.markdown:
The five strongest performers among the same **1,000 most liquid stocks**, from **January 2, 2025 through March 12, 2026**, were:

| Rank | Ticker | Return |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | DFDV | +3,653.45% [1] |
| 2 | AXTI | +2,033.79% [1] |
| 3 | ABVX | +1,504.66% [1] |
| 4 | CELC | +743.64% [1] |
| 5 | ASM | +673.21% [1] |

**None matches the five tickers listed in the earlier answer**—CHOW, BZAI, DFNS, AEBI, and ATOM. [1]

DFDV had 297 of 298 trading-session observations; the other four had complete coverage. [1]

**Limitations:** The recheck of the 2025 weakest ranking failed, so the overlap comparison uses the earlier answer’s ticker list rather than an independently reconfirmed ranking.
